description: Recent FEMA disaster declarations from LiveDataLink's self-hosted OpenFEMA index, with a live official-API fallback. Filter by state, county, incident type, or date range; returns disaster number, title, dates, incident category, and source freshness.

county.description: Designated area / county name as FEMA records it.

end_date.description: ISO date upper bound on declarationDate.

start_date.description: ISO date lower bound on declarationDate.

name: disaster_declarations
